story.iWant: practice typing numerical data in various formats
story.soThat: I can improve my numeric typing skills for professional use
story.tasks:
Task 1: Numbers Mode UI Implementation (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Create NumbersMode component extending TypingArea - Implement number format selection interface - Add mixed number-text practice options - Create number-specific visual feedback system
Task 2: Number Format Generation (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Generate diverse numerical data formats - Implement date format variations (MM/DD/YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY, ISO format) - Create phone number format generator (US, international formats) - Build calculation expression generator (simple arithmetic) - Implement mixed number-text content generation
Task 3: Numeric Input Optimization (AC: 4) - Optimize numeric keyboard layout for number pad usage - Implement enhanced visual feedback for number accuracy - Add number-specific cursor positioning and highlighting - Create number pad visual guides for desktop users
Task 4: Number-Specific Performance Tracking (AC: 5, 6) - Implement number-specific typing metrics - Track number pad accuracy separately from main keyboard - Create professional typing scenarios (invoices, forms, data entry) - Add numeric typing proficiency indicators
Task 5: Professional Scenarios Integration (AC: 6) - Create realistic data entry simulations - Implement form-filling practice scenarios - Add spreadsheet-style numeric entry practice - Build professional number typing challenges
Task 6: Testing and Quality Assurance (All ACs) - Unit tests for number format generation algorithms - Unit tests for numeric input validation - Integration tests with existing typing engine - Performance testing for number format rendering - Accessibility testing for number pad navigation

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. Given I select Numbers mode, when the mode loads then numerical data in various formats is generated 2. Given I select Numbers mode, when the mode loads then formats include dates, phone numbers, calculations 3. Given I select Numbers mode, when the mode loads then numbers can be mixed with text for realistic practice 4. Given I practice with numbers, when I type then numeric keyboard layout is optimized 5. Given I practice with numbers, when I type then accuracy with number pads is tracked 6. Given I practice with numbers, when I type then professional number typing scenarios are simulated
